mode: Real untimed solo practice; no blockchain transactions

files.caption: Get rich. Keep the lights on. A colony trading game you can play solo or with a friend.
Buy three oxygen and two tank fuel at the Depot. Check cargo space and the eight-credit cost.
Your rover arrives with its cargo and one tank fuel. Travelling and selling are separate moves.
Deliver oxygen, earn fifteen credits, and keep the Habitat supplied. The result records what happened.
Offer your oxygen to another merchant: three units at three credits each. You choose the price.
Tess buys the whole lot for nine credits. The trade history identifies the buyer, goods and payment.
The colony survives all twenty rounds. Final credits and remaining cargo determine the winner.
